relationships.subject: CK2
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate a critical role of nerve injury-inducing CK2 activity in the DRG in augmenting Ser394 phosphorylation of HDAC2.

relationships.subject: CX-4945
relationships.evidence_quote: CX-4945, a highly potent, ATP-competitive inhibitor of both isoforms of the CK2 catalytic subunits (α and α′)

relationships.subject: HDAC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Conditional HDAC2 knockout in DRG neurons causes α2δ-1 upregulation and neuropathic pain-like phenotype in mice (11)

relationships.subject: CX-4945
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with CX-4945 profoundly reduced the mRNA level of α2δ-1 in the DRG of SNL rats

relationships.subject: CX-4945
relationships.evidence_quote: the potent and specific CK2 inhibitor CX-4945 reversed pain hypersensitivity caused by nerve injury but had no effect on normal nociception in control rats

key_findings: Nerve injury increases CK2-HDAC2 interaction and Ser394 phosphorylation of HDAC2 in DRG, reducing HDAC2 occupancy at the Cacna2d1 promoter.
CK2 inhibition with CX-4945 reverses pain hypersensitivity, α2δ-1 upregulation and promoter histone hyperacetylation.
